title: Endorser's Obligation to Discontinue or Modify Advertisement

content.scenario: A celebrity endorses a product in a television advertisement. The Central Authority investigates and finds the advertisement to be false and misleading. The Authority directs the endorser to discontinue the advertisement within a specified time.
content.outcome: The endorser must discontinue or modify the advertisement as directed by the Central Authority, within the specified time, as per Section 21(1) of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019.

user_queries: What are the obligations of an endorser in India?
Can the Central Authority direct an endorser to discontinue an advertisement?
What happens if an endorser fails to comply with the Central Authority's direction?
